_comment: Tested model presets for a Cloud Run GPU (ml/cloudrun/deploy.py, infra/terraform). gpu_type: nvidia-l4 (24 GB) or nvidia-rtx-pro-6000 (96 GB, preview). hourly_usd: GPU + CPU + memory while the service is awake, without zonal redundancy, us-central1, approximate (October 2026; null = check the pricing page). temperature and params are the model card's recommended sampling settings. The landing page and docs/models.md show this table.

qwen3-vl-8b.name: Qwen3-VL 8B (FP8)
qwen3-vl-8b.description: Chat, vision and OCR in one model. The default: reads photos, screenshots, scans and charts.

qwen3-vl-4b.name: Qwen3-VL 4B
qwen3-vl-4b.description: The cheapest vision model: chat, photos, screenshots and OCR on the smallest instance.

qwen3-8b.name: Qwen3 8B (FP8, thinking)
qwen3-8b.description: Text only. Reasons step by step before answering: better at maths and logic, slower.

llama-3.1-8b.name: Llama 3.1 8B Instruct
llama-3.1-8b.description: Meta's widely used 8B model. Text only. In 16-bit on a 24 GB GPU, so a shorter context.

gemma-3-4b.name: Gemma 3 4B
gemma-3-4b.description: Google's small vision model: chat and images.

qwen3-32b.name: Qwen3 32B (FP8, thinking)
qwen3-32b.description: A much stronger text model, on the 96 GB RTX PRO 6000 (preview on Cloud Run, a few regions).
